description: This PHP source file generates a hierarchical role tree UI for the vtiger CRM system, retrieving role data from the database, constructing a nested HTML structure, and rendering it with Smarty templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine class used for rendering templates in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Recursively constructs an HTML nested list representing the role hierarchy, with expand/collapse icons and links for role selection or editing.
